title: eludite.debug.set_variable input
description: Change a value in the stopped debuggee, as editing a value in the Locals or Watch window does: a variable of a frame by `name`, or a member (`name`) of a value by its `reference` (from eludite.debug.variables or a stop summary at this stop). `value` is a C# expression the debugger evaluates (`42`, `"text"`, `order.Total + 1`), so it can run debuggee code. Through DAP setVariable, else setExpression where the adapter has only that, else refused (`capabilities.set_variable`). Only in break mode; the Locals and Watch windows show the new value. Next: continue, or read the value back with eludite.debug.variables.
x-eludite-escalates: Dangerous when the solution's policy sets `debug.drive` or `debug.evaluate` to `prompt`; refused for agents when either is `deny`.

name.description: The variable (a local or parameter of the frame) or, with `reference`, the member's name as eludite.debug.variables lists it.

value.description: The new value: a C# expression.

reference.description: The `reference` of the value whose member `name` is (at this stop). Not with `thread` or `frame`.

thread.description: A thread id. Default: the thread that stopped.

frame.description: Index in that thread's call stack (0 is the top). Default: 0, or the selected frame from the UI.

stop.description: The stop the caller saw (`stop` in eludite.debug.state). When given and the debuggee has stopped or resumed since, the command is refused as stale instead of acting on a state the caller did not see (two drivers, PLAN.md 5.5).
